newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Reuters 1st ex-Amsterdam Asia/MidEast air cargo rePORT.
newsitem.headline: Reuters 1st ex-Amsterdam Asia/MidEast air cargo rePORT.

text.p: This is Reuters' 1st ex-Amsterdam air cargo market report which only covers MidEast and Asian markets. It will be followed at a later by a separate report covering other destinations.
Below are the current average ex-Amsterdam Dutch guilder air cargo rates per kg for a 100 kg shipment with a volume-to-weight ratio of six-to-one.
*Rates to Bombay and Sydney have been added for the first time.

*The rates quoted in this report were obtained by Reuters journalists on a confidential basis from a range of airlines, large forwarders and smaller air cargo agents based at Amsterdan Schiphol airport. *All prices are quoted in Dutch guilders.
*The tariffs represent average rates calculated from a range of prices and are indicative of current market activity. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
